description: Add-ons and extra dealer charges, each under as many names, abbreviations and spellings as dealers print (ticket 142). Labels are read with the shared fee label matcher: terms match a label's words in order, a term word also matches a longer word it starts and a close misspelling. A line matching an entry's terms is named; a line matching only its possible terms is shown as possibly that entry; unless terms cancel the entry. Kinds drive the wording; no entry says whether a dealer may charge it. See docs/dealer-add-ons.md.

kinds.PRICE_INCREASE: A price increase on the car, not a service. It is negotiable.
kinds.POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE: May repeat a charge already on the paperwork.
kinds.FINANCE_PRODUCT: Optional product; you can decline it or buy it elsewhere.
kinds.MANUFACTURER_CHARGE: Usually set by the manufacturer and printed on the window sticker.

families.name: Charges that may repeat other charges
Products sold in the finance office

entries.name: paint protection
entries.what: A sealant, film or coating put on the paint, often by the dealer before the sale.
entries.question: Is the paint protection already on the car? If it is optional, will you take it off the price?

entries.name: fabric or interior protection
entries.what: A stain-resistant treatment for the seats, carpet or leather.
entries.question: Is the interior protection already applied? If it is optional, will you take it off the price?

entries.name: undercoating or rust proofing
entries.what: A coating or device sold to slow rust under or on the body.
entries.question: Is the undercoating already on the car? If it is optional, will you take it off the price?

entries.name: protection package
entries.what: A bundle of coatings or treatments sold under one name, such as an appearance or environmental package.
entries.question: What does the protection package include, and is it already on the car? If it is optional, will you take it off the price?

entries.name: ceramic coating
entries.what: A hard clear coating over the paint, sold as longer-lasting paint protection.
entries.question: Is the ceramic coating already on the car? If it is optional, will you take it off the price?

entries.name: VIN etching
entries.what: The vehicle identification number etched into the windows to discourage theft.
entries.question: Are the windows already etched? If the etching is optional, will you take it off the price?

entries.name: theft protection
entries.what: A theft deterrent product, registration or alarm, sometimes with a payment if the car is stolen.
entries.question: What does the theft protection do, and is it already installed? If it is optional, will you take it off the price?

entries.name: tracking or recovery device
entries.what: A GPS tracking or stolen-vehicle recovery device or subscription.
entries.question: Is the tracking device already installed, and is there a subscription? If it is optional, will you take it off the price?

entries.name: nitrogen-filled tires
entries.what: Tires filled with nitrogen instead of ordinary air, often marked with green valve caps.
entries.question: Are the tires already filled with nitrogen? If it is optional, will you take it off the price?

entries.name: wheel locks
entries.what: Locking lug nuts that need a special key to remove the wheels.
entries.question: Are the wheel locks already on the car? If they are optional, will you take them off the price?

entries.name: mud flaps or splash guards
entries.what: Flaps behind the wheels that catch spray and stones.
entries.question: Are the mud flaps already on the car? If they are optional, will you take them off the price?

entries.name: door edge guards
entries.what: Trim or film on the door edges and handle cups to prevent chips.
entries.question: Are the door edge guards already on the car? If they are optional, will you take them off the price?

entries.name: pinstripes
entries.what: Painted or vinyl stripes added along the body.
entries.question: Is the pinstripe already on the car? If it is optional, will you take it off the price?

entries.name: window tint
entries.what: Dark film put on the windows.
entries.question: Are the windows already tinted? If the tint is optional, will you take it off the price?

entries.name: floor mats
entries.what: Floor mats or liners, sometimes priced separately from the car.
entries.question: Did the floor mats come with the car? If they are optional, will you take them off the price?

entries.name: cargo tray or liner
entries.what: A tray, mat, net or liner for the trunk, cargo area or truck bed.
entries.question: Did the cargo tray come with the car? If it is optional, will you take it off the price?

entries.name: dealer-installed accessories
entries.what: Accessories the dealer added to the car after it left the factory.
entries.question: Which accessories are included, and are they already on the car? If they are optional, will you take them off the price?

entries.name: market adjustment
entries.what: An amount the dealer adds on top of the car's price.
entries.question: The market adjustment raises the car's price. Will you remove it or lower it?

entries.name: dealer addendum
entries.what: Items or an amount listed on a second sticker the dealer puts beside the window sticker.
entries.question: What is on the dealer addendum, and which items are already on the car? Will you remove the rest from the price?

entries.name: dealer premium package
entries.what: A package of items or an amount the dealer adds and names itself.
entries.question: What does the dealer package include, and is it already on the car? Will you remove it from the price?

entries.name: dealer preparation or pre-delivery inspection
entries.what: A charge for getting the car ready and inspecting it before delivery. On a new car this work is usually part of what the manufacturer pays the dealer for.
entries.question: What does the dealer preparation charge cover that is not already in the price or the destination charge?

entries.name: reconditioning
entries.what: A charge for repairs or cleaning before sale. It usually applies to a used car; on a new car it may repeat the preparation charge.
entries.question: What reconditioning was done, and is it already part of the car's price?

entries.name: destination or freight charge
entries.what: The charge for shipping the car to the dealer. The manufacturer sets one destination charge and prints it on the window sticker.
entries.question: Is this the destination charge printed on the window sticker? If the sticker already includes it, why is it on the paperwork again?

entries.name: dealer handling
entries.what: A charge the dealer names for handling the car or the sale.
entries.question: What does the handling charge cover that is not already in the price, the destination charge or the doc fee?

entries.name: service contract or extended warranty
entries.what: A contract that pays for some repairs after the factory warranty, sold for a set price and term.
entries.question: Is the service contract optional? What is its price on its own, and can I decline it?

entries.name: GAP coverage
entries.what: Coverage for the difference between what is owed on a loan and what insurance pays if the car is totaled or stolen.
entries.question: Is GAP coverage optional, and what does it cost on its own? My own insurer or lender may offer it too.

entries.name: tire and wheel protection
entries.what: A plan that pays for tire and wheel damage from road hazards.
entries.question: Is the tire and wheel protection optional? What is its price on its own, and can I decline it?

entries.name: key replacement
entries.what: A plan that pays to replace a lost or damaged key or fob.
entries.question: Is the key replacement plan optional? What is its price on its own, and can I decline it?

entries.name: dent and ding protection
entries.what: A plan that pays for small dent repairs without repainting.
entries.question: Is the dent protection optional? What is its price on its own, and can I decline it?

entries.name: windshield protection
entries.what: A plan that pays to repair or replace a chipped or cracked windshield.
entries.question: Is the windshield protection optional? What is its price on its own, and can I decline it?

entries.name: maintenance plan
entries.what: Prepaid oil changes or scheduled service.
entries.question: Is the maintenance plan optional? What is its price on its own, and can I decline it?

entries.name: credit life or disability insurance
entries.what: Insurance that makes loan payments, or pays off the loan, if the borrower dies, is disabled or loses a job.
entries.question: Is the credit insurance optional, and what does it cost on its own? Can I decline it?
